overview: Nebulae's Water Meter-based AMR is an industry-standard, battery-based device used for live reporting of consumption data from smart water meters. It is specifically designed to assist utilities with prompt alerts on tampering attempts, device removal or magnetic interference.

The device retrofits on existing meters and is plug-n-play: no configuration is required, and it sends live data at configured intervals after installation. It supports any diaphragm magnetic, inductive or RS485 pulse-based meter and works with LoRaWAN or Sigfox, communicating to a gateway/DCU and on to a network server or IoT middleware and the end-user application.

It offers 5+ years of battery life using deep sleep technology and requires zero maintenance. Operating temperature is −20 °C to +65 °C, ingress protection is IP65 (self-certified) and the device measures 97 × 59 × 37 mm.
